theory.intro: A binomial has two terms in its simplest form. To expand a product such as $(x+3)(x+5)$, multiply every term in the first bracket by every term in the second, then collect like terms.
facts: A **binomial** is an expression with **two** terms in its simplest form, such as $x+3$ or $2x-7$.
Multiplying every pair of terms gives $(a+b)(c+d)=ac+ad+bc+bd$ — **four** products in all.
Collect **like terms** after multiplying. In $(x+a)(x+b)$, the two middle products are like terms; in $(p+3)(q-4)$, they are not.
Keep the sign attached to each term: in $(x-5)(x+2)$ the second term of the first bracket is $-5$.
A squared bracket means multiplying the bracket by itself: $(x-4)^2=(x-4)(x-4)$.
steps: Multiply each term in the first bracket by each term in the second.

workedExamples.solution_text:
Multiply the side lengths of each smaller rectangle.
The four areas are $uv$, $5u$, $2v$ and $10$. Add them.
$(u+2)(v+5)$
$=u(v+5)+2(v+5)$
$=uv+5u+2v+10$
The terms $5u$ and $2v$ are unlike, so they cannot be collected.

(a) Multiply every term in the first bracket by every term in the second. A negative times a negative is positive.
$(x-7)(x-2)$
$=x^2-2x-7x+14$
$=x^2-9x+14$
(b) Keep the sign of $-5$.
$(2y-5)(3y+4)$
$=6y^2+8y-15y-20$
$=6y^2-7y-20$

(a) A square means multiplying the bracket by itself.
$(4z-3)^2$
$=(4z-3)(4z-3)$
$=16z^2-12z-12z+9$
$=16z^2-24z+9$
(b) Keep the negative sign attached to $-z$.
$(3z-5)(2-z)$
$=6z-3z^2-10+5z$
$=-3z^2+11z-10$

$(3a-b)(2a+5)$
$=3a(2a+5)-b(2a+5)$
$=6a^2+15a-2ab-5b$
There are no like terms to collect.

$(2x+a)(3x+b)$
$=2x(3x+b)+a(3x+b)$
$=6x^2+2bx+3ax+ab$
The terms $2bx$ and $3ax$ have different pronumeral parts, so leave them separate.

development.solution_text:
$(4a-3b)(5a+2)$
$=4a(5a+2)-3b(5a+2)$
$=20a^2+8a-15ab-6b$
There are no like terms to collect.

$(p+4)(q-3)$
$=p(q-3)+4(q-3)$
$=pq-3p+4q-12$
There are no like terms to collect.

A square means multiply the bracket by itself.
$(2x-3)^2=(2x-3)(2x-3)$
$=4x^2-6x-6x+9$
$=4x^2-12x+9$

mastery.solution_text:
$(3ax-2b)(4cx-5d)$
$=3ax(4cx-5d)-2b(4cx-5d)$
$=12acx^2-15adx-8bcx+10bd$
There are no like terms to collect.
